claims.evidence: The witness report does not describe the console's cleanliness.
The photo cannot show the country where the console was previously used.
Photo 0 shows 'PS4' on the top edge of the console.
Photo 0 shows one controller and a second vertical unit, not a second pad.
The witness report does not show cables, power cord, HDMI, or manuals.
The witness report does not show any game discs or cases.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or work.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen and reading a disc.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working console for parts.

risks.risk: Controller does not work or hold a charge.
risks.proof: Video of the controller syncing with the console and holding a charge.

risks.risk: Missing power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out next to the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console only with no accessories.

risks.risk: Storage capacity is lower than expected.
risks.proof: Photo of the system storage settings or the console label showing capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest capacity model.

risks.risk: Hidden faults, heavy wear, or unknown usage history.
risks.proof: Close-up video of ports, vents, and exterior, plus a functional test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily used with unknown faults.

risks.proof: Photo of the original box with the console.

risks.risk: No warranty or proof of purchase.
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of a valid warranty document or receipt.

risks.risk: The second vertical unit is not a pad and may be a second console or unrelated item.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the second unit to identify it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a single console only.

proof_requests: Video of the PS4 booting to the home screen and a controller being used.
Photo of all accessories, including cables, power cord, HDMI, and any game cases.
Photo showing the storage capacity label or system settings.
Clear photo of the second vertical unit behind the console.
response.reason: The witness identifies a PS4 console, so it can be priced at its worst case; all seller claims about condition, accessories, games, and the second pad remain unproven.
